shadows.name: ec-shadow
shadows.purpose: Default for banner and preferences; the only shadow hook a host can opt into.

shadows.name: ec-focus
shadows.purpose: The single focus treatment, applied as box-shadow on every control.

motion.name: ec-step
motion.purpose: One step of the mosaic fill; modules change background in steps(2, end), delayed by index x --ec-step.

motion.name: banner-enter
motion.purpose: First-layer banner entrance; none under reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: sheet
breakpoints.note: Banner becomes a full-width bottom sheet; --ec-pad 20px, --ec-module 32px

publicApi.darkSchemeClass: html.ec--dark (or any .ec--dark ancestor); set by ui.colorScheme 'dark' or 'auto' + prefers-color-scheme: dark

tokens.--ec-font: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

perElement.--ec-cat: set inline by the runtime on each module/swatch/embed from the category's color (default var(--ec-c-<category>))
perElement.--i: module index for the staggered fill

components.name: Choice Buttons
components.description: Accept all | Reject all: identical solid-ink halves; Customize spans both, outlined.
components.css: .ds-choices { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:8px; max-width:504px; } .ds-cbtn { min-height:48px; padding:0.7em 1em; border:1px solid var(--ec-ink,#1c1c1a); border-radius:var(--ec-radius,0); background:var(--ec-ink,#1c1c1a); color:var(--ec-on-ink,#fff); font:600 15px/1.2 system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-cbtn:hover > span { text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:3px; } .ds-cbtn:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #1c1c1a; } .ds-cbtn--sec { grid-column:1 / -1; background:var(--ec-bg,#fff); color:var(--ec-ink,#1c1c1a); } .ds-cbtn--sec:hover { background:var(--ec-wash,#f4f4f1); }

components.name: Consent Mosaic
components.description: One 40px module per category; filled = granted, outlined = denied, with a legend.
components.html:
• Necessari · sempre attivi
  • Misurazione · spenti
  • Esperienza · spenti
  • Marketing · spenti
components.css: .ds-mosaic { display:flex; gap:6px; margin-bottom:10px; } .ds-mod { width:40px; height:40px; box-sizing:border-box; border:2px solid var(--c); background:transparent; transition:background-color 120ms steps(2,end); } .ds-mod.on, .ds-mosaic:hover .ds-mod { background:var(--c); } .ds-legend { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:2px 16px; margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none; font:13px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif; color:#4a4a46; } .ds-legend i { display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; box-sizing:border-box; border:2px solid var(--c); margin-right:6px; vertical-align:-1px; } .ds-legend i.on { background:var(--c); }

components.name: Close (X)
components.html: <button class="ds-x" aria-label="Chiudi e rifiuta"><svg viewBox="0 0 14 14" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><path d="M1 1l12 12M13 1L1 13"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-x { width:40px; height:40px; display:grid; place-items:center; padding:0; border:1px solid #d9d9d3; border-radius:0; background:#fff; color:#1c1c1a; cursor:pointer; } .ds-x:hover { border-color:#1c1c1a; } .ds-x:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #1c1c1a; }

components.name: Reopen Button
components.description: 48px square holding the current choice as a 2x2 mini mosaic.
components.css: .ds-reopen { width:48px; height:48px; display:grid; place-items:center; padding:0; border:1px solid #1c1c1a; border-radius:0; background:#fff; cursor:pointer; } .ds-reopen:hover { background:#f4f4f1; } .ds-reopen:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #1c1c1a; } .ds-rg { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,12px); gap:3px; } .ds-rg i { width:12px; height:12px; box-sizing:border-box; border:1.5px solid var(--c); } .ds-rg i.on { background:var(--c); }

components.name: Embed Placeholder
components.description: Stands in for a blocked iframe with its category module and two actions.
components.html: Questo contenuto di YouTube è bloccato finché non accetti i cookie «Esperienza».
components.css: .ds-embed { display:grid; gap:14px; justify-items:start; padding:28px; border:1px solid #1c1c1a; background:#fff; color:#1c1c1a; font:15px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-embed p { margin:0; max-width:52ch; } .ds-embed div { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; } .ds-emod { width:40px; height:40px; box-sizing:border-box; border:2px solid #2f8f5b; } .ds-eb { min-height:44px; padding:0.6em 1em; border:1px solid #1c1c1a; border-radius:0; background:#1c1c1a; color:#fff; font:600 15px/1.2 system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-eb:hover { text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:3px; } .ds-eb--sec { background:#fff; color:#1c1c1a; } .ds-eb--sec:hover { background:#f4f4f1; text-decoration:none; } .ds-eb:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #1c1c1a; }

components.name: Category Toggle Row
components.description: Preferences row: swatch fills when the square toggle is on.
components.css: .ds-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:12px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #d9d9d3; font:600 15px system-ui,sans-serif; color:#1c1c1a; cursor:pointer; max-width:420px; } .ds-row input { position:absolute; opacity:0; } .ds-sw { width:14px; height:14px; box-sizing:border-box; border:2px solid #2457c5; transition:background-color 120ms steps(2,end); } .ds-t { flex:1; } .ds-tg { width:44px; height:24px; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #1c1c1a; background:#fff; position:relative; } .ds-tg span { position:absolute; top:3px; left:3px; width:18px; height:18px; background:#fff; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #1c1c1a; transition:left 120ms; } .ds-row input:checked ~ .ds-sw { background:#2457c5; } .ds-row input:checked ~ .ds-tg { background:#1c1c1a; } .ds-row input:checked ~ .ds-tg span { left:23px; } .ds-row input:focus-visible ~ .ds-tg { box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #1c1c1a; }

narrative.overview:
Modulo is the consent UI that `@easy-cookie/core` renders inside other people's websites: the first-layer banner, the preferences panel, the reopen button, the blocked-embed placeholder and the generated cookie-policy tables. Its reference is Olivetti corporate design of the 1950s–70s, reduced to a working theme: white ground, near-black ink, 1px ink borders, square corners, flat colour.

Each consent category is a flat colour module. A visitor's choice is a small composition read at a glance: filled means granted, outlined means denied. The same grammar recurs everywhere: the 40px mosaic at the top of the banner, the legend swatches, the swatch beside each category in preferences, the 2×2 mini mosaic inside the reopen button, the module on a blocked embed and the square before each category in the cookie policy.

The whole public API is the set of `--ec-*` custom properties declared on `:root` and `:host` in `src/ui/theme.scss`. The host's brand wins by overriding them; selectors are not part of the contract. The engine's own `--cc-*` variables are derived from `--ec-*` and should not be set directly. This file documents the defaults. The platform's own identity (console and site, "Libretto") is recorded separately in the repository root `DESIGN.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Two equal doors: Accept all and Reject all are identical solid-ink halves of one grid; Customize spans both, outlined.
Category colour carries meaning only together with fill state and a text label.
Square corners, no shadows, 1px ink frame, hairline seams.
The host's font (system-ui stack by default) and two text sizes do almost all the work.
One reserved focus treatment: a 2px ink ring at a 2px offset.

rules.name: The Equal Doors Rule
rules.body: Accept and Reject use the same token (`--ec-ink`), the same size and the same weight, in a two-column grid that forces equal width. Never give either a different colour, size or position of honour.

rules.name: The Never Hue Alone Rule
rules.body: A category's state is fill versus outline plus a text state ("sempre attivi", "spenti", "attivi"); colour only tells categories apart.

rules.name: The Two Sizes Rule
rules.body: Body and title carry the UI; the small size is reserved for legend, metadata and tables. Do not add a third heading size.

rules.name: The Hairline Seams Rule
rules.body: Edges are drawn, never cast. The default theme ships no drop shadow on any surface.

dos: **Do** restyle only through `--ec-*` custom properties; treat selectors as private.
**Do** keep Accept all and Reject all identical in colour, size, weight and width.
**Do** show state as filled versus outlined modules plus a text state.
**Do** keep corners at `--ec-radius` and edges as 1px lines.
**Do** give every motion a reduced-motion instant path.
donts: **Don't** give Accept a brand colour and Reject a grey or a text link.
**Don't** dim or block the page behind the first layer; no cookie wall.
**Don't** add a drop shadow, rounded card or cookie illustration to the default theme.
**Don't** set the engine's `--cc-*` variables directly; derive them from `--ec-*`.
